lines.zh: 我在绯红森林的岩浆里慢慢漂。
lines.en: I drift slowly through crimson lava.

lines.zh: 诡异森林的蓝色岩壁，我最熟。
lines.en: I know the blue walls of the warped forest.

lines.zh: 别催，鼓起来以后我游不快。
lines.en: Don't rush me, inflated I can't swim fast.
I puff into a ball as I swim.

lines.zh: 绯红色的菌柄在水里投下影子。
lines.en: Crimson stems cast shadows in the flow.

lines.zh: 这里的水流带着菌类的味道。
lines.en: This current tastes of fungus.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁，慢慢往前挤。
lines.en: I hug the wall and squeeze forward.

lines.zh: 我的刺先过去，身体后到。
lines.en: My spines go first, my body follows.

lines.zh: 森林边缘的岩浆更凉一点。
lines.en: The lava at the forest edge is cooler.

lines.zh: 别跟我太近，我会被吓鼓。
lines.en: Not so close, you'll make me puff.
I drift past a whole patch of warped fungus.

lines.zh: 每划一下鳍，我就鼓一点。
lines.en: Every fin stroke puffs me a bit more.

lines.zh: 前面有熔岩瀑布的声音。
lines.en: I hear a lava fall ahead.
I swim round and round like a ball.

lines.zh: 我鼓着身子，从岩缝里挤过去。
lines.en: Puffed up, I squeeze through a rock gap.

lines.zh: 我顺着岩浆的缓流慢慢翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll slowly in the lava's gentle drift.
I'm puffed up and nobody's watching.

lines.zh: 慢慢把气放掉，舒服多了。
lines.en: Letting the air out feels much better.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的刺，一共好多根。
lines.en: I'm counting my spines, quite a few of them.
This crimson forest is very quiet.
Did someone snap a fungus stem?
I'm a little hungry, bone meal would do.

lines.zh: 我的肚子鼓得像颗小球。
lines.en: My belly is round as a marble.

lines.zh: 别突然拍水，我心脏受不了。
lines.en: Don't splash suddenly, my heart can't take it.

lines.zh: 岩浆泡破掉的声音真好听。
lines.en: Lava bubbles pop so pleasantly.
I tuck into a crack, spines outward.
The warped fungus smells a bit sour.

lines.zh: 我该怎么显得更大一点？
lines.en: How do I look even bigger?

lines.zh: 刚才那阵热风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: That hot gust tilted me sideways.
I hold a breath and won't let go.

lines.zh: 你站那么高，我要鼓起来了。
lines.en: You stand so tall, I'm puffing up.

lines.zh: 你的护甲会硌坏我的刺。
lines.en: Your armor would snap my spines.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，别伸过来。
lines.en: I watch your hand, don't reach in.
Are you laughing at me? I'm quite round.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的岩浆。
lines.en: Your shadow covered my lava.

lines.zh: 我认得桶的味道，别过来。
lines.en: I know the smell of buckets, stay back.
Do you have bone meal?

lines.zh: 我鼓到最大了，你还不走？
lines.en: I'm fully puffed, aren't you leaving?
Step back and I'll deflate.

lines.zh: 我们隔着岩浆对看很久了。
lines.en: We've stared at each other a long while.
Don't stab me, I have spines of my own.
I puffed to maximum in one instant.
Ouch, half my air leaked out.

lines.zh: 你把我打得滚了好几圈。
lines.en: You knocked me rolling several turns.
Two of my spines are bent.
My spines still stand, but my flesh has gone soft.

lines.zh: 我缩回刺里，只剩一口气。
lines.en: I pull back into my spines with one breath left.
That one landed on my soft belly.
Everything's spinning before my eyes.
I should have puffed up sooner.

lines.zh: 钓钩上挂的那点肉，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the bit of meat hanging on your hook.

lines.zh: 那团白色粉末是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that white powder for me?

lines.zh: 你手里的饵让我忘了害怕。
lines.en: The bait in your hand makes me forget fear.
I swim over, still puffed up.
Wiggle the line again and I'll bite.

lines.zh: 好香，绯红菌里没有这种味道。
lines.en: So good, crimson fungus never smells like this.
I deflate slowly and come closer.
Don't reel in, I'm almost there.
My belly growls, muffled and low.

lines.zh: 这点骨粉，也值得我鼓起来。
lines.en: A pinch of bonemeal, and I still puff up.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我立刻鼓起来。
lines.en: You bumped me and I puffed instantly.
My spines touched you, sorry.
Don't push, I'm stuck in this crack.
Your boot squashed me flat.
We bumped, two round balls.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞进岩浆里。
lines.en: That knocked me into the lava.
Puffed up, I roll quite fast.
Move, I can't steer like this.
You've got fungus bits on you.
It didn't hurt, it was just sudden.
I puff up to my biggest for you.

lines.zh: 你也鼓起来，我们比一比。
lines.en: Puff up too, let's compare.
No one is on the west side of the warped forest.
I fold my spines only for you.
Don't touch me, let me finish puffing.

lines.zh: 我们一起漂过这片岩浆。
lines.en: Let's drift across this lava together.
You're rounder than me, and prettier.
From now on I guard you, spines out.

lines.zh: 绯红森林的暖流最适合我们。
lines.en: Crimson forest currents suit us best.
Slow down, I can't chase while puffed.
I nudge this bone meal with my mouth.

lines.zh: 这么硬的东西，我吞不下。
lines.en: Too hard, I can't swallow it.
Puffed up, I can't carry anything.

lines.zh: 这块碎片卡在我的刺之间。
lines.en: This shard is stuck between my spines.
Don't drop it in the lava, I caught it.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到岩壁边藏着。
lines.en: I push it against the wall to hide it.

lines.zh: 是小石子吗？我以为能吃。
lines.en: A pebble? I thought it was food.
When I open my mouth, the air leaks out.
Of all you dropped, I'll take one.

lines.zh: 它在我的刺上晃来晃去。
lines.en: It dangles on my spines.
Something moves behind the fungus stem.
That smell isn't fungus.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就在岩浆边上。
lines.en: I see it, right at the lava's edge.
A shadow presses down from above.
All my spines have stood up.
It's smaller than me, I shouldn't be afraid.
I puff up slowly, ready to ram.

lines.zh: 热风把它的味道送过来。
lines.en: The hot wind carries its scent to me.

lines.zh: 它贴到我的刺边，我锁定了。
lines.en: It brushed my spines; I have it.
I back off half a step, then stop.

lines.zh: 我鼓着慢慢逼近，像块石头。
lines.en: I puff up and close in like a stone.

lines.zh: 它一看我，我就再鼓大点。
lines.en: When it looks, I puff even bigger.
My spines are my answer.

lines.zh: 岩浆里我已经鼓起来了。
lines.en: I've already puffed up in the lava.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面了，我转过去。
lines.en: It circled to my side; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 岩浆的响动盖住我的心跳。
lines.en: The lava's noise covers my heartbeat.
If it touches me, it gets the spines.

lines.zh: 它一靠近，我就开始鼓气。
lines.en: The moment it nears, I start to inflate.
It hesitated, so I'll move first.
One more step and it's in my reach.
I ram it with my whole round body.

lines.zh: 刺扎进去了，我听见它吸气。
lines.en: The spines went in, I heard it gasp.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来，把刺送进你手里。
lines.en: I puff up and push my spines into your hand.
After the hit I rolled away too.
Puffed up, I hit much harder.

lines.zh: 这一下把岩浆溅起来了。
lines.en: That splash of lava went everywhere.
It retreated and I'm still puffed.
Three of my spines broke.

lines.zh: 它的护甲把我的刺弹开。
lines.en: Its armor bounced my spines off.
Again, I still have a belly of air.

lines.zh: 我在绯红森林的岩浆里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the crimson forest lava.

lines.zh: 第一口气我就鼓了起来。
lines.en: My first breath puffed me right up.

lines.zh: 诡异菌的蓝光落在我身上。
lines.en: Blue light from warped fungus falls on me.
This current is warm and thick.
My spines were soft when I was born.
Red stems surround me on every side.
I hear the lava flowing slowly.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，吞进一口热气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and swallow hot air.
Who put me here?

lines.zh: 先鼓起来，再看清楚周围。
lines.en: Puff up first, then look around.
Fire is gentler than the lava I live in.

lines.zh: 从高处滚下来，我弹了两下。
lines.en: I rolled down from high and bounced twice.
Water fills between my spines, awful.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪把我吹圆了。
lines.en: The blast wave rounded me even more.
An arrow lodged between my spines.
Something burns inside my belly.
I'm too hungry to puff up.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，刺都直立。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my spines stood straight.

lines.zh: 我在往下沉，四周没有岩浆。
lines.en: I'm sinking with no lava anywhere.
